row.title: SITE-INSIGHTS-1 built-site visitors drive upkeep spend
row.body: Serving a built site records a cookieless first-party view (seed/analytics, path /s/<id>, DNT honoured, bots excluded); /s/<id>/insights shows 7/30 day views, referrers, countries, devices; the weekly model pass runs only for sites with a view in 30 days, so AI spend follows traffic.

title: SITE-INSIGHTS-1 built-site visitors drive upkeep spend
